name: Box sign-in
description: Signs a Box account in through Box's own authorization endpoint.

codes.box_oauth.bad_reply: Box sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.box_oauth.client_not_configured: This account has no registered Box application yet. Enter the client ID and the client secret of your own Box app first.
codes.box_oauth.client_refused: Box did not accept this application. Check the client ID and the client secret, and that the redirect URI is registered exactly.
codes.box_oauth.code_expired: The sign-in expired before it was finished. Start it again.
codes.box_oauth.consent_denied: The sign-in was not granted at Box.
codes.box_oauth.flow_unsupported: Box is signed in through the browser, not with a device code.
codes.box_oauth.no_entropy: The sign-in could not be started because the application had no randomness for it. Try again.
codes.box_oauth.refresh_refused: Box no longer accepts the stored sign-in. Sign in again.
